`MetaboSetR` preprocesses Biocrates MxP Quant 1000 WebIDQ exports and runs
metabolite-level feature statistics together with curated pathway-set
enrichment (GSEA / ORA). See `docs/DESIGN.md` for the full design.

A full worked example will be added here.
